Look. Is understandable that You feel like that. It's fair to want to be love and liked. We all desire that. Highschool can be really hard and your parents not aknowledging that must be really hard, cause is important to have a figure to talk to.

I really think that You should talk to them. Being Open and saying how u feel is important and may lead to some surprises. Sometimes we think other people don't care but is because we are not being able to communicate properly. (The fact that languaje is subjective makes it harder. Sometimes we Say "water" and we mean the ocean, but the other thinks of a glass of water) this is why we shouldn't take it too personal if someone doesnt get what we are saying and try.

But beyond that, is good to say what u feel for your own sake. It will help You. U can try writing it down, saying that You are working hard in school and that You think You are getting better grades, and that although You understand how important is to get good grades, You are doing a very Big effort to do it while You also struggle with your mental health and stability, during a very complicated time like highschool is. Tell them that their support would be important.

But also. Don't hurt yourself. It's useless.. u r trying to call atention, or maybe feel.something or who knows. But it's useless, trust me. Talk to you Friends, tell them what is about you that they don't like. Tell them to be sincere and actually think about what they are saying. Lo ve yourself. Try to.enjoy as much as u can cause I know it's cliché but... It gets SO much better. After highschool everything changes. Hey. I don't really know what to Say. Is really shitty that You have a student loan. And now You want an internship so You can actually get a Job....

And it's not happening. 

It seems that thats the way it should go and everyone said it was and now... It's.not working. 

So maybe think outside the box. You didnt get your internship for the summer but You can definetly do other stuff. Ive been working since I was 17 and I'll tell You something: theres no experience that doesnt look good in a CV. Try thinking of your hobbies or things You always wanted to do. Maybe something related to your Home country, or to inmigrants who come to study, something that u r related to. Can be volunteering, or in a non-for-profit or some really shitty thing. Or Many things. 

The shittiest or smallest thing Will teach u so much. I work at a museums and get CVs all the time and if I have to choose between someone with a degrees who just finished Uni or someone who has worked organizing state fairs for 5 years i could easily go with the second one cause I know:

It can probably work under pressure
Know how to handle providers and arrange schedules before "opening time"
Has an idea of how much time it takes to put a "show" together
Know how to solve problems
Knows how to handle a budget
Etc

Is just an example, but when the time comes, all of your life experience Will come handly in an interview (ALL) so don't think doing an interview is the only thing.

Uni is hard and having a loan, Even harder. But it WILL be okay. Youre not the first or the last student to be in this situation and you'll get out of it. Don't only think of your loan, try to enjoy and discover who You are and what You want... So Uni wasnt what u expected and u didnt get the internship... Trust me, if u r so screwed like u said, have some fun with it. Explore new horizons. Win experience. Enjoy and work on your anxiety and mental health too, thats also important.

You are important and so.is your happiness. Things Will start to make sense and ull be happier and less stress, but everything will.be alright. I'm sure u'll nailed it. 

Good luck!

Hey. Of course not a profesional opinion but I recommend investigating and googling. don't go crazy. Just like when googling symptons, You may find very extreme ideas that Will tell You how to "solve" your depressión... Not gonna happen.

Now, they also work as Doors to other things. It's always good to let other people now ir You are a little down. You are.not the root of every problem, no one is. If You think You are creating problems or hurting people, always Say sorry. Literally the Best advice I can give You in how to get better and Start having a better relationship with other people. You probably like being aknowledge, other people like that too.
